correctness.rationale: Let Psi=(N,d), a=||MN||F, s=||M||F,r=||c||2. The composed data are A=MNM,b=MNc+Md+c. Schatten Holder gives ||A||_1 <= a s, and ||b||2 <= ar+||Md||2+r. The exact source Lemma 7, applied to this qubit positive TP Psi and auxiliary M, yields ||Md||2+a<=s. Sum <=s+r+a(s+r-1)<=1 when s+r<=1; source Proposition 5 then makes the composite EB. Since Phi is not already EB, filtered index equals two; the ideal property under all left/right unitaries forces n(U Phi)=2 for each U. For GAD p=1/5,gamma=3/5, s=sqrt(11)/5, r=4/25, s+r<1 because 275<441, while p=125/625>gamma(1-gamma)(1-p)^2=96/625 so it is not EB. The critical external lemmas were inspected in Lami-Giovannetti primary full text; independent exact fractional checks reproduce the witness, without treating them as proof of the general claim.
